gaps: The shared commission source, asynchronous worker branch, RED/GREEN tests, real process proof, independent review and reconciliation are not complete at gate creation.
The current CommissionsService cache is not hydrated by worker account refresh, so persisted calculations can be omitted from scheduled output; no empty-success fallback is authorized.
Delegated scouts did not return a verdict within the bounded continuation window; no independent scout consensus exists.
conditions: Keep the result limited to the authenticated tenant-scoped scheduled read path over persisted commission calculations and same-account line counts and the exact six-field catalog contract.
Do not add commission writes, rule/payment lifecycle, staff/patient/billing joins, API/SPA changes, additional fields/filters or provider behavior.
Do not add migrations because the commission tables and existing tenant rails already exist.
Keep CVG-004/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation request and original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled commission-calculations report source through the real worker
authority.decision: Authorize only the repository-local read-only commissions report source, asynchronous worker resolution/bootstrap wiring and disposable two-account verification under the existing schedule/audit semantics. The source may expose only number, periodStart, periodEnd, status, totalBaseAmount, totalCommissionAmount and lineCount from persisted commission_calculations plus same-account commission_lines, derive tenant scope from the claimed schedule, apply strict status and period-overlap filters, deterministic created_at/id order and a 10,000-row bound, and fail closed on missing/foreign/malformed source output. Exclude commission writes/rules/payment lifecycle, staff/patient/billing joins, API/SPA changes, migrations, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation, backfill and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing commission schema/RLS, calculation/line status or amount semantics, worker schedule/audit behavior, adding joins/fields/filters, commission lifecycle, provider delivery, target operations or production behavior.

next_action: Write and run the intentional commission-source, worker and real process RED tests, then implement the smallest bounded tenant-aware persisted source and PostgreSQL proof.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to commission calculation/line schema, status/amount/date semantics or tenant RLS/FORCE-RLS policy
Changes to worker bootstrap, schedule claiming, report execution/export/audit or one-shot failure behavior
Expansion beyond scheduled commission-calculations or the existing six-field contract
